title: On the Nonexistence of Continuous Immersions for Discrete-time Systems
summary: Understanding when linear immersions of nonlinear dynamical systems exist is important since such immersions allow us to leverage the rich tools of linear system theory to analyze nonlinear dynamics. Recently, Liu et al. (2023) showed that continuous-time dynamical systems that admit countably many but more than one omega-limit sets cannot be immersed into finite dimensional linear systems with a one-to-one and continuous mapping.
